ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. This section is restricted for students in HRD Cohorts 17 & 18. Blackboard Collaborate (also known as Elluminate) will be used. Elluminate synchronous sessions will be held from 7 to 8:30 pm CST on the following dates: July 17 & 31, Aug. 14 & 28, Sept. 11, Sept. 18 (optional session), Oct. 23, Nov. 6 & 27, & Dec. 4. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers, waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC, or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.).
